SOFO Events Calendar

Our events calendar shows all the events that are upcoming at SOFO museum.You can view more information about an event by mousing over the title.

If you would like to join us for an event please click on the title and you will be taken through to the shop where you can book tickets, if applicable.

Once you have completed your purchase, you will be emailed with a confirmation. Login and go to 'My Account' to view your purchased bookings, digital images and records.
